product.description: This Toolless keystone jack series allows you to terminate Cat5e, Cat6, and Cat6A jacks without the use of a punch down tool. This keystone jack is backwards compatible with components and systems of lower performing categories. Use in standard keystone wallplates, patch panels, or surface mount boxes.
